profile.headline: WordPress Developer | WooCommerce | PHP | Full-Stack | SEO Optimization
profile.jobTitle: Chief Information Officer (CIO) | Web Developer | E-commerce Specialist
profile.summary: Detail-oriented Web Developer with expertise in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, WordPress and Magento, experienced in creating and managing dynamic, high-performance websites. Skilled in using Google Analytics and SEO best practices to optimize site performance and user engagement. Proficient in maintaining CMS platforms, ensuring websites meet accessibility and security standards, and managing client content to align with branding. Adept at troubleshooting, resolving website issues, and delivering a seamless user experience. Passionate about collaborating with teams to build exceptional websites that drive business growth.

positions.title: Chief Information Officer (CIO) | Web Developer | E-commerce Specialist
positions.description:
As CIO, I lead the strategic planning and implementation of technology solutions that drive business growth and digital transformation. My focus is on aligning technology initiatives with business goals, ensuring scalability, performance, and innovation across platforms.

Key Responsibilities & Achievements:
- Defined and executed IT and digital strategies to support e-commerce operations and online business growth.
- Supervised system integrations, data management, and automation workflows to enhance efficiency.
- Managed website infrastructure and hosting environments to ensure uptime, security, and scalability.
- Collaborated cross-functionally with marketing and design teams to align technical execution with brand and business objectives.
- Oversaw SEO and analytics initiatives, translating insights into actionable optimizations for higher visibility and engagement.
- Built and maintained custom WordPress websites, optimizing content delivery for better user experience and SEO performance.
- Troubleshot and resolved performance issues, ensuring SEO best practices were followed for high visibility in search engines.
- Optimized websites for search engine visibility by implementing best SEO practices across content, meta tags, and images.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management Software · WordPress · Capacidad de análisis · Gestión de relaciones con clientes (CRM) · Problem Solving

positions.title: Magento Developer & E-commerce Specialist
positions.description:
•	Developed, maintained, and optimized e-commerce websites using Magento, focusing on user experience, performance, and troubleshooting across different browsers.
•	Designed responsive web pages using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript frameworks, ensuring websites were mobile-friendly.
•	Collaborated with clients to design and implement custom solutions, resolving issues related to browser compatibility and functionality.
•	Managed site performance with tools like Google Analytics to monitor traffic, user engagement, and optimize page load speeds.
•	Ensured the security of web pages, implemented backup and disaster recovery procedures, and followed best practices for web security.
